# Unicode

## Scripts

- Accents (precomposed NFC): café, naïve, Zürich
- Accents (decomposed NFD): café, naïve, Zürich
- Greek: Ελληνικά
- Cyrillic: Русский текст
- CJK: 日本語のテキスト、中文、한국어
- Arabic (right-to-left): مرحبا بالعالم
- Hebrew (right-to-left): שלום עולם
- Devanagari: नमस्ते दुनिया

## Symbols

- Astral plane: 𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢 and 𝟙𝟚𝟛
- Emoji with skin tone: 👋🏽
- Emoji ZWJ sequence: 👩‍💻 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
- Flags: 🇨🇦 🇯🇵
- Zero-width joiner alone: a‍b
- Non-breaking space: a b
- Combining marks: q̣̇ Z͑ͫ̓ͪ̂ͫ̽͏̴̙̤̞͉͚̯̞̠͍
